meta.title: Onwards, Party Girl!
meta.description: A party is a battlefield that a girl must face alone.

units.rawText: Jiangyu? Are you sure you're alright?
units.displayText: Jiangyu? Are you sure you're alright?

spans.text: Jiangyu? Are you sure you're alright?

units.rawText: I-I'm fine! Just need a bit of practice... left... r-right, woah...
units.displayText: I-I'm fine! Just need a bit of practice... left... r-right, woah...

spans.text: I-I'm fine! Just need a bit of practice... left... r-right, woah...

units.rawText: From the Rest Area came the sound of heavy objects colliding with one another.
units.displayText: From the Rest Area came the sound of heavy objects colliding with one another.

spans.text: From the Rest Area came the sound of heavy objects colliding with one another.

units.rawText: The sounds alone were enough for me to identify the person behind the door, but I knock nonetheless.
units.displayText: The sounds alone were enough for me to identify the person behind the door, but I knock nonetheless.

spans.text: The sounds alone were enough for me to identify the person behind the door, but I knock nonetheless.

units.rawText: Hm? Who is it?
units.displayText: Hm? Who is it?

spans.text: Hm? Who is it?

units.rawText: Ksenia, are you there?
units.displayText: Ksenia, are you there?

spans.text: Ksenia, are you there?

units.rawText: Ah, Professor! Welcome!
units.displayText: Ah, Professor! Welcome!

spans.text: Ah, Professor! Welcome!

units.rawText: P-Professor?! Hang on, I'll be right there!
units.displayText: P-Professor?! Hang on, I'll be right there!

spans.text: P-Professor?! Hang on, I'll be right there!

units.rawText: Calm down, Jiangyu!
units.displayText: Calm down, Jiangyu!

spans.text: Calm down, Jiangyu!

units.rawText: Don't just go and stand up, it's dangerous!
units.displayText: Don't just go and stand up, it's dangerous!

spans.text: Don't just go and stand up, it's dangerous!

units.rawText: Huh? Ahhhh, you're going to fall—
units.displayText: Huh? Ahhhh, you're going to fall—

spans.text: Huh? Ahhhh, you're going to fall—

units.rawText: As the door opens, before I can even utter a word, a familiar figure loses their balance and crashes into me.
units.displayText: As the door opens, before I can even utter a word, a familiar figure loses their balance and crashes into me.

spans.text: As the door opens, before I can even utter a word, a familiar figure loses their balance and crashes into me.

units.rawText: Jiangyu? You alright?
units.displayText: Jiangyu? You alright?

spans.text: Jiangyu? You alright?

units.rawText: Ehehe... thanks, Prof, I'm fine!
units.displayText: Ehehe... thanks, Prof, I'm fine!

spans.text: Ehehe... thanks, Prof, I'm fine!

options.rawText: Never thought that our big martial arts star would have a day of falling over like this.
options.displayText: Never thought that our big martial arts star would have a day of falling over like this.

spans.text: Never thought that our big martial arts star would have a day of falling over like this.

options.rawText: I seem to remember you starring in movies where you wore heels, no?
options.displayText: I seem to remember you starring in movies where you wore heels, no?

spans.text: I seem to remember you starring in movies where you wore heels, no?

units.rawText: Gah... but these shoddy floaty shoes really are awful...
units.displayText: Gah... but these shoddy floaty shoes really are awful...

spans.text: Gah... but these shoddy floaty shoes really are awful...

units.rawText: Jiangyu rubs her fingers in embarrassment, trying to smooth over some of her awkwardness.
units.displayText: Jiangyu rubs her fingers in embarrassment, trying to smooth over some of her awkwardness.

spans.text: Jiangyu rubs her fingers in embarrassment, trying to smooth over some of her awkwardness.

units.rawText: Ahaha, it'd be fine if all I had to do was walk normally...
units.displayText: Ahaha, it'd be fine if all I had to do was walk normally...

spans.text: Ahaha, it'd be fine if all I had to do was walk normally...

units.rawText: But Sis, she... she wants me to learn how to walk "properly", and mentioned something about being... cultured and refined?
units.displayText: But Sis, she... she wants me to learn how to walk "properly", and mentioned something about being... cultured and refined?

spans.text: But Sis, she... she wants me to learn how to walk "properly", and mentioned something about being... cultured and refined?

units.rawText: Cultured and refined...
units.displayText: Cultured and refined...

spans.text: Cultured and refined...

units.rawText: I follow Jiangyu's sight downwards to find a delicate pair of heels on her feet.
units.displayText: I follow Jiangyu's sight downwards to find a delicate pair of heels on her feet.

spans.text: I follow Jiangyu's sight downwards to find a delicate pair of heels on her feet.

units.rawText: It's too damn difficult to walk with such thin heels! It'd be easier to walk on stilts!
units.displayText: It's too damn difficult to walk with such thin heels! It'd be easier to walk on stilts!

spans.text: It's too damn difficult to walk with such thin heels! It'd be easier to walk on stilts!

units.rawText: I've got it! I'll just chuck these, and go to the event barefoot! Or slip in after it's already begun!
units.displayText: I've got it! I'll just chuck these, and go to the event barefoot! Or slip in after it's already begun!

spans.text: I've got it! I'll just chuck these, and go to the event barefoot! Or slip in after it's already begun!

units.rawText: Where did the Jiangyu that snuck all the way here to practice go?
units.displayText: Where did the Jiangyu that snuck all the way here to practice go?

spans.text: Where did the Jiangyu that snuck all the way here to practice go?

units.rawText: Are you going to give up just like this?
units.displayText: Are you going to give up just like this?

spans.text: Are you going to give up just like this?

units.rawText: Uwah... I'll give it another go. I can't embarrass Sis and the Professor like this!
units.displayText: Uwah... I'll give it another go. I can't embarrass Sis and the Professor like this!

spans.text: Uwah... I'll give it another go. I can't embarrass Sis and the Professor like this!

units.rawText: Jiangyu straightens her back, slowly taking a step forward.
units.displayText: Jiangyu straightens her back, slowly taking a step forward.

spans.text: Jiangyu straightens her back, slowly taking a step forward.

units.rawText: That's the way. You went to the trouble of putting on such a nice outfit, after all.
units.displayText: That's the way. You went to the trouble of putting on such a nice outfit, after all.

spans.text: That's the way. You went to the trouble of putting on such a nice outfit, after all.

units.rawText: Jiangyu, shift your weight onto the back of the heel. Keep your knees straight and maintain your balance.
units.displayText: Jiangyu, shift your weight onto the back of the heel. Keep your knees straight and maintain your balance.

spans.text: Jiangyu, shift your weight onto the back of the heel. Keep your knees straight and maintain your balance.

units.rawText: With Ksenia's guidance, Jiangyu slowly inches forward.
units.displayText: With Ksenia's guidance, Jiangyu slowly inches forward.

spans.text: With Ksenia's guidance, Jiangyu slowly inches forward.

units.rawText: Ohhh! I think I'm getting the feel of it!
units.displayText: Ohhh! I think I'm getting the feel of it!

spans.text: Ohhh! I think I'm getting the feel of it!

units.rawText: Do make sure to shift your center of gravity towards your toes when you're going up the stairs, though. Otherwise, you might end up having an intimate meeting with the floor.
units.displayText: Do make sure to shift your center of gravity towards your toes when you're going up the stairs, though. Otherwise, you might end up having an intimate meeting with the floor.

spans.text: Do make sure to shift your center of gravity towards your toes when you're going up the stairs, though. Otherwise, you might end up having an intimate meeting with the floor.

units.rawText: You seem familiar with this whole "wearing heels" business.
units.displayText: You seem familiar with this whole "wearing heels" business.

spans.text: You seem familiar with this whole "wearing heels" business.

units.rawText: Hehe, I'm the best waitress in the Oasis! This level of skill is only natural... huh? Jiangyu, what's wrong?
units.displayText: Hehe, I'm the best waitress in the Oasis! This level of skill is only natural... huh? Jiangyu, what's wrong?

spans.text: Hehe, I'm the best waitress in the Oasis! This level of skill is only natural... huh? Jiangyu, what's wrong?

units.rawText: Master! Teach me the way of the heels!
units.displayText: Master! Teach me the way of the heels!

spans.text: Master! Teach me the way of the heels!

units.rawText: Jiangyu takes a few exaggerated strides towards Ksenia, bowing deeply with one fist cupped in her other hand.
units.displayText: Jiangyu takes a few exaggerated strides towards Ksenia, bowing deeply with one fist cupped in her other hand.

spans.text: Jiangyu takes a few exaggerated strides towards Ksenia, bowing deeply with one fist cupped in her other hand.

units.rawText: Huh? Ehhhhh?
units.displayText: Huh? Ehhhhh?

spans.text: Huh? Ehhhhh?

units.rawText: But I still have to help with the celebrations' arrangements...
units.displayText: But I still have to help with the celebrations' arrangements...

spans.text: But I still have to help with the celebrations' arrangements...

units.rawText: I can help you with that!
units.displayText: I can help you with that!

spans.text: I can help you with that!

units.rawText: Well...
units.displayText: Well...

spans.text: Well...

units.rawText: Ksenia casts a furtive glance in my direction.
units.displayText: Ksenia casts a furtive glance in my direction.

spans.text: Ksenia casts a furtive glance in my direction.

units.rawText: Ksenia, there's still some time before the Anniversary celebrations begin. Would you mind teaching her?
units.displayText: Ksenia, there's still some time before the Anniversary celebrations begin. Would you mind teaching her?

spans.text: Ksenia, there's still some time before the Anniversary celebrations begin. Would you mind teaching her?

units.rawText: Well, I guess it can't be helped. I had hoped to save my big surprise for everyone on the day of the celebration.
units.displayText: Well, I guess it can't be helped. I had hoped to save my big surprise for everyone on the day of the celebration.

spans.text: Well, I guess it can't be helped. I had hoped to save my big surprise for everyone on the day of the celebration.

units.rawText: Since Jiangyu is making such a heartfelt request, I suppose I'll share my secrets with you out of the goodness of my heart!
units.displayText: Since Jiangyu is making such a heartfelt request, I suppose I'll share my secrets with you out of the goodness of my heart!

spans.text: Since Jiangyu is making such a heartfelt request, I suppose I'll share my secrets with you out of the goodness of my heart!

units.rawText: Ksenia turns on her heel and disappears into the employee area of the Rest Area, quickly reemerging before us in a new outfit.
units.displayText: Ksenia turns on her heel and disappears into the employee area of the Rest Area, quickly reemerging before us in a new outfit.

spans.text: Ksenia turns on her heel and disappears into the employee area of the Rest Area, quickly reemerging before us in a new outfit.

units.rawText: Ta-da! What do you think? This is the special gear I've prepared for the occasion!
units.displayText: Ta-da! What do you think? This is the special gear I've prepared for the occasion!

spans.text: Ta-da! What do you think? This is the special gear I've prepared for the occasion!
Very much your style.

options.rawText: Don't forget to enjoy the celebration yourself while you're serving everyone.
options.displayText: Don't forget to enjoy the celebration yourself while you're serving everyone.

spans.text: Don't forget to enjoy the celebration yourself while you're serving everyone.

units.rawText: Hehe, they'll see just how determined a Doll of the service industry can be!
units.displayText: Hehe, they'll see just how determined a Doll of the service industry can be!

spans.text: Hehe, they'll see just how determined a Doll of the service industry can be!

units.rawText: Ehehe, as long as everyone's satisfied~ and leaves generous tips, I'll be more than happy!
units.displayText: Ehehe, as long as everyone's satisfied~ and leaves generous tips, I'll be more than happy!

spans.text: Ehehe, as long as everyone's satisfied~ and leaves generous tips, I'll be more than happy!

units.rawText: I-It's possible to walk THIS fast with heels?
units.displayText: I-It's possible to walk THIS fast with heels?

spans.text: I-It's possible to walk THIS fast with heels?

units.rawText: Heheh, if you just follow what I do, you can do it too!
units.displayText: Heheh, if you just follow what I do, you can do it too!

spans.text: Heheh, if you just follow what I do, you can do it too!

units.rawText: First, puff out your chest, raise your head, and extend your right hand. Ensure your center of gravity is on your heel...
units.displayText: First, puff out your chest, raise your head, and extend your right hand. Ensure your center of gravity is on your heel...

spans.text: First, puff out your chest, raise your head, and extend your right hand. Ensure your center of gravity is on your heel...

units.rawText: L-Like this?
units.displayText: L-Like this?

spans.text: L-Like this?

units.rawText: Jiangyu begins to imitate Ksenia, moving forward with some grace and style.
units.displayText: Jiangyu begins to imitate Ksenia, moving forward with some grace and style.

spans.text: Jiangyu begins to imitate Ksenia, moving forward with some grace and style.

units.rawText: The formerly stumbling girl begins to grow more familiar with the motions, her steps becoming more and more ladylike.
units.displayText: The formerly stumbling girl begins to grow more familiar with the motions, her steps becoming more and more ladylike.

spans.text: The formerly stumbling girl begins to grow more familiar with the motions, her steps becoming more and more ladylike.

units.rawText: That's it, she's getting the essence of it! Time for the advanced lessons, then!
units.displayText: That's it, she's getting the essence of it! Time for the advanced lessons, then!

spans.text: That's it, she's getting the essence of it! Time for the advanced lessons, then!

units.rawText: Hold on to that feeling you've got. Put your right hand forward.
units.displayText: Hold on to that feeling you've got. Put your right hand forward.

spans.text: Hold on to that feeling you've got. Put your right hand forward.

units.rawText: Eh? What does that signify?
units.displayText: Eh? What does that signify?

spans.text: Eh? What does that signify?

units.rawText: Then give them your best smile, and a little implication by the way of a look...
units.displayText: Then give them your best smile, and a little implication by the way of a look...

spans.text: Then give them your best smile, and a little implication by the way of a look...

units.rawText: A-an implication?
units.displayText: A-an implication?

spans.text: A-an implication?

units.rawText: Then put into your pocket the most generous of tips with your left hand.
units.displayText: Then put into your pocket the most generous of tips with your left hand.

spans.text: Then put into your pocket the most generous of tips with your left hand.

units.rawText: The most generous of tips... huh?!
units.displayText: The most generous of tips... huh?!

spans.text: The most generous of tips... huh?!

units.rawText: Wait! That's what it's meant for?
units.displayText: Wait! That's what it's meant for?

spans.text: Wait! That's what it's meant for?

units.rawText: Heheh. That's my secret weapon. Impeccable manners, the finest service, the most confident smile.
units.displayText: Heheh. That's my secret weapon. Impeccable manners, the finest service, the most confident smile.

spans.text: Heheh. That's my secret weapon. Impeccable manners, the finest service, the most confident smile.

units.rawText: You can leave this anniversary's service all to me!
units.displayText: You can leave this anniversary's service all to me!

spans.text: You can leave this anniversary's service all to me!

units.rawText: You must be really looking forward to this, Ksenia.
units.displayText: You must be really looking forward to this, Ksenia.

spans.text: You must be really looking forward to this, Ksenia.

units.rawText: Hehe, a lot has happened today, you know.
units.displayText: Hehe, a lot has happened today, you know.

spans.text: Hehe, a lot has happened today, you know.

units.rawText: Ksenia's head lowers, her eyes sweeping across her legs.
units.displayText: Ksenia's head lowers, her eyes sweeping across her legs.

spans.text: Ksenia's head lowers, her eyes sweeping across her legs.

units.rawText: But no matter what came our way, good or bad, we've all done our very best this year.
units.displayText: But no matter what came our way, good or bad, we've all done our very best this year.

spans.text: But no matter what came our way, good or bad, we've all done our very best this year.

units.rawText: So since we're having a day to commemorate the year, I ought to give everyone the best service I can offer.
units.displayText: So since we're having a day to commemorate the year, I ought to give everyone the best service I can offer.

spans.text: So since we're having a day to commemorate the year, I ought to give everyone the best service I can offer.

units.rawText: Hehe, I understand.
units.displayText: Hehe, I understand.

spans.text: Hehe, I understand.

units.rawText: I see Ksenia's gone above and beyond... alright... I must redouble my efforts too!
units.displayText: I see Ksenia's gone above and beyond... alright... I must redouble my efforts too!

spans.text: I see Ksenia's gone above and beyond... alright... I must redouble my efforts too!

units.rawText: Jiangyu stands upright again, her steps continuing with renewed purpose. She dashes through the small Rest Area, a spring in her step.
units.displayText: Jiangyu stands upright again, her steps continuing with renewed purpose. She dashes through the small Rest Area, a spring in her step.

spans.text: Jiangyu stands upright again, her steps continuing with renewed purpose. She dashes through the small Rest Area, a spring in her step.

units.rawText: Looks like there's nothing to worry about over here... Oh right, here are your invites.
units.displayText: Looks like there's nothing to worry about over here... Oh right, here are your invites.

spans.text: Looks like there's nothing to worry about over here... Oh right, here are your invites.

units.rawText: I produce the invitation letters and extend them to the ladies.
units.displayText: I produce the invitation letters and extend them to the ladies.

spans.text: I produce the invitation letters and extend them to the ladies.

units.rawText: Eh? But I've already got an invitation.
units.displayText: Eh? But I've already got an invitation.

spans.text: Eh? But I've already got an invitation.

units.rawText: Same here. Me, Nascita, and Magnhilda were all there! Did you forget or something?
units.displayText: Same here. Me, Nascita, and Magnhilda were all there! Did you forget or something?

spans.text: Same here. Me, Nascita, and Magnhilda were all there! Did you forget or something?

units.rawText: ...Is that so... Sorry, then, I must have forgotten.
units.displayText: ...Is that so... Sorry, then, I must have forgotten.

spans.text: ...Is that so... Sorry, then, I must have forgotten.

units.rawText: Since that's the case, I'll get out of your hair and let you practice, Jiangyu.
units.displayText: Since that's the case, I'll get out of your hair and let you practice, Jiangyu.

spans.text: Since that's the case, I'll get out of your hair and let you practice, Jiangyu.

units.rawText: Enjoy the Anniversary celebrations, everyone.
units.displayText: Enjoy the Anniversary celebrations, everyone.

spans.text: Enjoy the Anniversary celebrations, everyone.

units.rawText: Yeah! I will!
units.displayText: Yeah! I will!

spans.text: Yeah! I will!

units.rawText: P-Professor, wait just a second... hold me for a second...
units.displayText: P-Professor, wait just a second... hold me for a second...

spans.text: P-Professor, wait just a second... hold me for a second...

units.rawText: Jiangyu's legs buckle beneath her, and she collapses onto me once again.
units.displayText: Jiangyu's legs buckle beneath her, and she collapses onto me once again.

spans.text: Jiangyu's legs buckle beneath her, and she collapses onto me once again.

units.rawText: I've overdone it a bit... my legs feel like jelly...
units.displayText: I've overdone it a bit... my legs feel like jelly...

spans.text: I've overdone it a bit... my legs feel like jelly...

units.rawText: It would appear that Jiangyu has... quite a way to go before she'll measure up to Daiyan's standards.
units.displayText: It would appear that Jiangyu has... quite a way to go before she'll measure up to Daiyan's standards.

spans.text: It would appear that Jiangyu has... quite a way to go before she'll measure up to Daiyan's standards.
